# Kamisato Ayato — Complete Character Reference

## Overview
- **Name**: Kamisato Ayato
- **Title**: Pillar of Fortitude
- **Rarity**: ★★★★★
- **Element / Vision**: Hydro
- **Weapon Type**: Sword
- **Nation**: Inazuma
- **Affiliation**: Yashiro Commission
- **Constellation**: Cypressus Custos
- **Birthday**: 0000-03-26
- **Special Dish**: None

> The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commisson's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

## Combat Talents

### Normal Attack: Kamisato Art - Marobashi
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.
Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to dash forward and perform an iai.
Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- 1-Hit DMG: 44.96%
- 2-Hit DMG: 47.16%
- 3-Hit DMG: 58.61%
- 4-Hit DMG: 29.45% x 2
- 5-Hit DMG: 75.6%
- Charged Attack DMG: 129.53%
- Charged Attack Stamina Cost: 20
- Plunge DMG: 63.93%
- Low / High Plunge DMG: 127.84% / 159.68%

### Elemental Skill: Kamisato Art: Kyouka
Kamisato Ayato shifts positions and enters the Takimeguri Kanka state. After this shift, he will leave a watery illusion at his original location. After it is formed, the watery illusion will explode if opponents are nearby or after its duration ends, dealing AoE Hydro DMG
Takimeguri Kanka
In this state, Kamisato Ayato uses his Shunsuiken to engage in blindingly fast attacks, causing DMG from his Normal Attacks to be converted into AoE Hydro DMG. This cannot be overridden. It also has the following properties:
After a Shunsuiken attack hits an opponent, it will grant Ayato the Namisen effect, increasing the DMG dealt by Shunsuiken based on Ayato's current Max HP. The initial maximum number of Namisen stacks is 4, and 1 stack can be gained through Shunsuiken every 0.1s. This effect will be dispelled when Takimeguri Kanka ends.
Kamisato Ayato's resistance to interruption is increased.
Unable to use Charged or Plunging Attacks.
Takimeguri Kanka will be cleared when Ayato leaves the field. Using Kamisato Art: Kyouka again while in the Takimeguri Kanka state will reset and replace the pre-existing state.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Shunsuiken 1-Hit DMG: 52.89%
- Shunsuiken 2-Hit DMG: 58.91%
- Shunsuiken 3-Hit DMG: 64.93%
- Takimeguri Kanka Duration: 6s
- Namisen DMG Bonus: 0.56% Max HP/Stack
- Water Illusion DMG: 101.5%
- Water Illusion Duration: 6s
- CD: 12s

### Elemental Burst: Kamisato Art: Suiyuu
Unveils a garden of purity that silences the cacophony within. While this space exists, Bloomwater Blades will constantly rain down and attack opponents within its AoE, dealing Hydro DMG and increasing the Normal Attack DMG of characters within.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Bloomwater Blade DMG: 66.46%
- Normal Attack DMG Bonus: 11%
- Duration: 18s
- CD: 20s
- Energy Cost: 80

## Passive Talents

### Kamisato Art: Mine Wo Matoishi Kiyotaki (Unlocked at Ascension 1)
Kamisato Art: Kyouka has the following properties:
After it is used, Kamisato Ayato will gain 2 Namisen stacks.
When the water illusion explodes, Ayato will gain a Namisen effect equal to the maximum number of stacks possible.

### Kamisato Art: Michiyuku Hagetsu (Unlocked at Ascension 4)
If Kamisato Ayato is not on the field and his Energy is less than 40, he will regenerate 2 Energy for himself every second.

### Kamisato Art: Daily Cooking (Unlocked Automatically)
When Ayato cooks a dish perfectly, he has a 18% chance to receive an additional "Suspicious" dish of the same type.

## Constellations

### C1: Kyouka Fuushi
Shunsuiken DMG is increased by 40% against opponents with 50% HP or less.

### C2: World Source
Namisen's maximum stack count is increased to 5. When Kamisato Ayato has at least 3 Namisen stacks, his Max HP is increased by 50%.

### C3: To Admire the Flowers
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Kyouka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C4: Endless Flow
After using Kamisato Art: Suiyuu, all nearby party members will have 15% increased Normal Attack SPD for 15s.

### C5: Bansui Ichiro
Increase the Level of Kamisato Art: Suiyuu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C6: Boundless Origin
After using Kamisato Art: Kyouka, Ayato's next Shunsuiken attack will create 2 extra Shunsuiken strikes when they hit opponents, each one dealing 450% of Ayato's ATK as DMG. Both these Shunsuiken attacks will not be affected by Namisen.

## Ascension Materials
- **Level 20**: Varunada Lazurite Sliver ×1, Sakura Bloom ×3, Old Handguard ×3, Mora ×20000
- **Level 40**: Varunada Lazurite Fragment ×3, Dew of Repudiation ×2, Sakura Bloom ×10, Old Handguard ×15, Mora ×40000
- **Level 50**: Varunada Lazurite Fragment ×6, Dew of Repudiation ×4, Sakura Bloom ×20, Kageuchi Handguard ×12, Mora ×60000
- **Level 60**: Varunada Lazurite Chunk ×3, Dew of Repudiation ×8, Sakura Bloom ×30, Kageuchi Handguard ×18, Mora ×80000
- **Level 70**: Varunada Lazurite Chunk ×6, Dew of Repudiation ×12, Sakura Bloom ×45, Famed Handguard ×12, Mora ×100000
- **Level 80**: Varunada Lazurite Gemstone ×6, Dew of Repudiation ×20, Sakura Bloom ×60, Famed Handguard ×24, Mora ×120000
